# Source-occasion fixtures

- `claude-fork-user-copies.jsonl`: four content-safe native request records from the approved disposable Claude Code 2.1.296 fork/resume characterization. UUIDs survive the fork while sessionId changes.
- `claude-interactive-origins.jsonl`: synthetic IDs, content and parents with origin tuples reported by read-only aggregation of 17 local interactive Claude project transcripts during review. This is not a captured transcript: the characterized tuples are typed/human/external, suggestion_accepted/human/external and system/task_notification/external. Tests exercise them through public input loading. No private transcript content is included.
